_note: Exon-resolution breakpoints for the fusions in fusion_frame_trap.FUSIONS. EVERY row's exon numbers are read off the `quote` field, which is a VERBATIM span of an abstract Europe PMC returned into fusion-frame-trap-inputs.json under the identifier in `source_id`. fusion_frame_trap.verify_quotes() locates each quote character-for-character in that committed corpus and the module refuses to emit an artifact if any quote cannot be found. Nothing here was typed from recollection, and a fusion with no locatable breakpoint statement has no row and is counted INDETERMINATE.
_limits: A quote is evidence of what the record says. It is not evidence that the breakpoint it names is the only, commonest or canonical one for that entity.

Exon numbers in the literature are counted on whichever transcript that paper used. Where the 3' partner has more than one distinct first exon across its protein-coding transcripts, the row is graded INDETERMINATE unless `three_prime_transcript_named` is true.
A row states one junction. Several entities have more than one recurrent junction; where the corpus states more than one, each is a separate row.

_schema.fusion: the FUSIONS id this junction belongs to
_schema.junction: a short label for this particular junction
_schema.five_prime_exon: transcript exon rank of the 5' partner's last retained exon, or null if the source does not fix it
_schema.three_prime_exon: transcript exon rank of the 3' partner's first retained exon, or null
_schema.five_prime_transcript_named: true only if the source names the 5' partner transcript/isoform its exon numbering is counted on

evidence.source_id: the Europe PMC id/PMID/PMCID/DOI the quote is taken from
evidence.quote: verbatim span of that record's abstract

_schema.note: free text; never a source of a number
